script: How did a Taco Bell commercial hide the best player in the world? See, while the broadcast showed burritos, the Nuggets quietly used pick 41 on Nikola Jokic. No highlight package, just his name on the bottom of the screen. Scouts said he was too slow, too soft, more horse ranch than weight room, but every summer he came back slimmer, with better touch and wild passing. In Denver, he turned from goofy second rounder into the center running the whole offense. Now the guy drafted during a fast food ad is stacking triple doubles, winning MVPs, and knocking out teams that spent lottery picks trying to stop him.
what_makes_it_work: Capitalizes on the viral trivia fact that an NBA MVP was drafted during a Taco Bell commercial.
Uses high-energy pacing and rapid edits contrasting Jokic's humble beginnings with his current dominance.
Emphasizes Jokic's unique persona, from loving horses to hitting unbelievable clutch shots.
